clauses.clause: Same city as L4 (pair cameras read "same place, fallen"); sun intensity falls ≥ 30 % to the metro.
clauses.note: All16 current matched-camera captures inspected: four authored L4/L5 camera pairs at both tiers have exactly equal positions/targets and1280x720 framing. Same plaza/convoy arrangement, Harbor cafe, Metro sign/frontage and Kessler fence/tree/block remain identifiable; L5 adds shattered facades, wrecks, bodies and fog. Heavy plaza fog is disclosed. Actual L5 renderer sun drops from0.816 to0.44965 (44.90%) by metro/end, exceeding30%; sim end multiplier0.5. P: PO: do matched L4/L5 views read as the same place, fallen? Sun intensity reduction remains a numeric clause. No taste verdict is claimed. Native named photo-preset lookup was unavailable, so the existing authored offsets were applied as explicit identical cinematic poses.
